process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before executing: 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. git rev-parse/status and gh pr view/diff were all unavailable, so the PR's changed-file set, diff, head SHA and intent could not be read.

No reviewers were spawned: without a readable diff, reviewers (which depend on the same Bash tool for gh pr diff / git diff) could only have reviewed the config-restore paths visible via .claude-pr/, and would have missed any non-config changes while presenting the result as a full review. PR #72 was NOT reviewed this round; re-run once the runner sandbox permits Bash (nested user namespaces / CAP_SYS_ADMIN for seccomp setup).
